presets.name: Dynamic Hero Orbit
presets.description: Smooth orbital camera sweep around your subject with cinematic rim lighting and natural wind physics.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the reference subject and setting. Keep the subject identity, facial features, hairstyle, and outfit strictly consistent. One continuous four-second cinematic shot as the camera executes a smooth orbital arc and slow push-in around the subject. Warm golden-hour rim light shifts naturally across the contours of the face and coat while a gentle breeze moves hair strands and fabric with realistic physics. Subtle, lifelike eye contact and calm micro-expression. No cuts, no morphing, no text or watermarks. Audio: atmospheric coastal breeze and warm cinematic room tone, no speech or copyrighted music.

presets.name: Cinematic Action Tracking
presets.description: Low-angle tracking motion through a rain-glossed neon street with realistic stride and reflections.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the reference character and environment. Keep the exact character face, jacket, and urban setting. One continuous four-second tracking shot as the camera glides smoothly backward at waist height while the character walks forward with a confident, energetic stride through a rain-washed neon street. Wet pavement reflections ripple naturally under footsteps, coat hem moves with realistic momentum, and background neon bokeh shifts with natural parallax. Stable anatomy, no cuts, no text or logos. Audio: crisp footsteps on wet pavement and soft evening rain ambience, no voiceover or recognizable song.

presets.name: Macro Commercial Reveal
presets.description: Precision studio macro sweep across product textures with volumetric mist and specular highlights.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the exact hero product and studio tabletop reference. Preserve the object geometry, metallic and glass textures, and pedestal placement. One continuous four-second commercial macro shot as the camera performs a slow, fluid orbital dolly reveal around the product. Specular studio highlights glide smoothly across the brushed metal and crystal surfaces while delicate atmospheric mist drifts softly in the background. Razor-sharp focus on the hero product, no distortion, no text overlays. Audio: refined studio ambience with subtle mechanical and crystalline resonance, no speech.
